title: Native Anthropic case-resolution agent
subtitle: Reason, call a BPMN tool, and return a structured recommendation
description: A self-contained AI Agent Sub-process using Camunda 8.10's native Anthropic provider, reasoning controls, prompt caching, a deterministic fromAi() policy tool, bounded calls, structured output, and credential-free process and connector-runtime tests.
creator: Camunda
thumbnailAlt: BPMN model showing a case entering a native Anthropic AI Agent subprocess with a deterministic resolution-policy script tool, followed by structured-result validation and separate success and failure end events.

variables.caseRequest: A customer reports a duplicate express-delivery charge after order ORD-9472 arrived three days late. Classify this as a billing case with severity 4, consult the resolution policy, and recommend the next action.
variables.policyContext: Use the checked-in demo-input.json value for the full reusable prompt prefix.
